title: Repository-owned shared examples
summary: The root examples tree contains 287 canonical reusable HTML-first demonstrations consumed by 294 Markdown page-example relations, with optional JavaScript and local assets published by Docara. The component slice contains 72 example blocks covering every one of the 63 ordinary Framework components; examples use public SIMAI Framework classes, expose their executed HTML/JavaScript through Docara tabs and contain no project-owned presentation CSS. Image-dependent utility examples use a minimal project-owned visual system instead of brand marks or generic placeholders. Deterministic audits guard registry coverage, duplication, responsive layout, accessibility semantics and Markdown authoring hygiene.
